title: Binance Will List Bonfida (FIDA)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Bonfida (FIDA) and will open trading for FIDA/BTC, FIDA/BNB, FIDA/BUSD, and FIDA/USDT trading pairs at 2021-09-30 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  FIDA  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for FIDA will open at 2021-10-01 06:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Bonfida (FIDA)? Bonfida is an ecosystem built on Solana and consists of products including (1) an on-chain perpetual swap; (2) Solana name service for auctioning and transacting readable Solana addresses; and (3) Bonfida Bots which allow users to automate trading strategies and do copy-trading on Serum DEX. The FIDA token is the native token of the Bonfida platform with all products and their fees accruing value to the FIDA token. FIDA is also used for fee discounts, as staking rewards, and governance. FIDA Listing Fee: 0 BNB. Details: FIDA Website FIDA Block Explorer Fees Rules Risk warning : Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously.
